messages:
emma: quick follow-up from our architecture sync  want a compact, tenant-scoped safepath for canary/A-B that avoids flip-flop and keeps cost predictable.
tariq: aggree. tradeoff: local fast decision vs global caps. propose local decisioner + central control-plane for caps and policy pushes.
yun: signals: sliding p95(20s), in-flight queue, kv-hit-rate, small-eval quality-flag, recent-fallback-count. operator override channel.
mike: fallback ordering guidance: prefer same-family lower-precision -> sibling with KV affinity -> cached-last-good -> truncated-summary. avoid cross-family unless explicit opt-in.
emma: oscillation controls: require stability window (e.g., condition holds for N seconds) + per-tenant cooldown + leaky-bucket limit on fallbacks per minute.
tariq: runtime note: keep per-tenant state only for hot tenants in an LRU. cold tenants use control-plane defaults. LRU size tunable.
yun: session affinity: try to pick co-located fallback nodes to preserve KV continuity; otherwise return cached-last-good with header x-safepath-warning.
mike: API sketch (route-level, tiny):
route=/v1/generate
safepath.enabled=true
safepath.budget_ms=150
safepath.stability_s=3
safepath.cooldown_s=30
safepath.fallbacks=["rwdx-8q","rwdx-6b-q","cached_short"]

emma: telemetry: structured reason codes {capacity, latency_spike, quality_regression, operator_override, probe_timeout}, include tenant_id, route, variant, safepath_id, token_delta_est.
tariq: rollout plan: observe-only in one region -> opt-in internal tenant 48-72h -> small external cohort. measure fallback-rate, latency delta, and token-cost delta.
yun: ops playbook: page if fallback-rate >1% sustained 15m OR >500 events in 10m OR quality_regressions >3 in 1h. provide console kill-switch.
mike: tests: deterministic sim for bursty arrivals, integration test for affinity-preserving fallback, chaos test with region outage, unit tests for hysteresis/eviction.
emma: next steps: I'll draft an RFC with sample DSL, sim harness, and playbook. will link RFC here when ready :thumbsup:
